title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Running Stitch. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Every option keeps the brief's pins: shadcn/ui, green/amber/red/blue/purple status colours, light + dark, split-screen auth.

options.label: Running Stitch
options.lineage: Nakshi kantha, the running-stitch quilt of Bengal
options.thesis: Every working day is a stitch; a month of attendance reads like a kantha row.
materials: running stitch as the data mark
options.viewport: Indigo nav rail; today's card with live clock and one Check-in action; the month below as a stitched row of 31 days in status thread; balances as stitched quotas.
options.risk: Folk craft tips into costume if stitches leave the data; they stay on data marks only.

raised.raise: State lives in stitch form too: solid is final, dashed is pending, struck is cancelled. Colour never works alone.
On a phone, check-in owns the whole first screen: clock, shift, one action.
Figures sit on a fixed size ramp, so the day's one number outranks everything near it.
Everything snaps to a 4px stitch module, and grids reflow by whole cells.
Rules are drawn at one device pixel: three ink values plus the thread colours, nothing else.

options.label: Line 6
options.thesis: The workday is a metro line: shift start, grace and check-out are stations you pass on time or late.
options.viewport: Top bar with navigation; today's line runs across the full width with stations at 9:00, 9:15 grace, and you; the month sits below as a station index.
options.risk: Familiar: a timeline-as-transit-map is where many runs land, and it can read as a stock stepper.

options.label: Monochrome Product
options.thesis: An almost colourless instrument where the status colours are the only colour on the screen.
options.viewport: Narrow grey sidebar; dense KPI strip; check-in as a solid accent button; every number paired with a sparkline as proof.
options.case: Fuses cleanly, and reviewers know this polish. It loses on audience identity: nothing about it belongs to this office.
options.risk: Reads as a well-made clone of every SaaS dashboard.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: State carried by line height, dash and doubling on a charcoal continuum.
options.viewport: One off-centre rail with every destination as a tick.
options.case: Fuses poorly: office staff don't read spectrograms, and hue-free state fights the pinned status colours.
options.kept: State is carried in line form (solid, dashed, struck), not by hue alone.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: One item owns the whole viewport, and the next is a snap away.
options.viewport: One record per screen with an action rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: attendance data is tabular and comparative, not one item at a time.
options.kept: On a phone, check-in owns the whole first screen with one action.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Importance as dot magnitude on a coordinate field.
options.viewport: Employees plotted as stars by department.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a night-sky chart has nothing to say about an office day.
options.risk: Decorative where it should be legible.
options.kept: Hierarchy on a fixed magnitude ramp: figures sized by importance, never ad hoc.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Letterforms and layout built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: A grid-built clock as a poster.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a poster's monumentality competes with dense working tables.
options.kept: One strict module that every element snaps to.

options.label: Centre-Rail Setting
options.thesis: Twin text columns around a rail of keys, drawn by a ruling engine.
options.viewport: Two narrow columns with a keyed centre rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a reading edition is the wrong form for approvals and check-ins.
options.risk: Reads as a book, not a tool.
options.kept: Rule discipline: hairlines at one device pixel and very few ink values.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A stock shadcn/ui admin dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: White sidebar, top bar with search, a row of four KPI cards, then a chart and a table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other HR dashboard, by design.
